plugins.name: fable-advisor
plugins.description: Role pool: any model can be the main agent; two postures (orchestrating: deliverables only through a worker; implementing: the main agent may edit directly); explorer, worker, and advisor at light, standard, and senior; grok, codex, claude, and handoff lanes. User-side fill table maps (role, tier) to models; GPT family via the codex runner (currently GPT-6 Astra default).
